## Hypothesis

Testing the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON signal at 1-2 DTE weekly options (same ITM-2 strike, same -8%/+30% exit) instead of 0DTE aims to capture the weekly options pay edge observed in WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate (OOS $59-66/tr, p<=0.045) while maintaining the same directional signal structure. This isolates DTE as the variable to reduce theta decay and extend ribbon ride duration.

## Mechanism

Identical BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger (level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence at 09:35 ET or later) but contracts selected with 1-2 DTE weekly expiration (same ITM-2 strike as 0DTE baseline). Exit rules preserved: catastrophic premium stop at -8%, profit target at +30%. Position sizing per risk-rules.md (min 3 contracts). No changes to entry timing, filters, or management logic beyond DTE adjustment.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=3 contracts requires ~$1.2K+ account for 50% risk cap at ~$1.00 entry premium (per risk-rules.md position sizing schedule). $1K paper account scales to 42% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 evaluates 225 trades across 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-30 (IS+OOS mixed). OOS window specified as 2025 Q3 to 2026 Q2 per task, but Stage-1 does not isolate OOS period. High overfit risk due to no walk-forward or regime stratification in Stage-1.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (Stage-1 does not separate IS/OOS; quarterly P&L shows 2025-Q3:-$1134.66, 2026-Q2:-$101.59 but no trade count or per-trade OOS edge).
